text:
rachael: noticed odd behavior in the latency pane for /v1/embeddings-canary — p50 stable, p95 jumps ~200ms, p99 flat. canvas shows "merged" by default. anyone have quick theories? :confused:
tk: merged percentiles often mix ingress/retry/backend. if a small fraction of requests hit a slow path (e.g. fallback model), p95 can move without p99 shifting much.
omar: metric-bot says there were a couple fallback events at 14:12 that added ~180ms. also a kvcache miss cluster at 14:10.
rachael: so this is provenance-related. our clients expect "request end-to-end" but product folks read dashboard as "backend only" which causes confusion.
liz: proposal: add a compact provenance pill next to the percentiles that reads either "merged" or lists the origin used (backend/ingress/kvcache). clicking it toggles an expanded view showing p50/p95/p99 per origin with sample counts. hover shows a short explanation.
ui-ux-lee: I can design a small pill + popover. idea: default collapsed -> shows merged numbers; popover table: Origin | p50 | p95 | p99 | samples. small footnote: "Percentiles computed on request end-to-end unless 'backend-only' selected."
tk: telemetry change: ensure route telemetry sets origin for every event. if origin=null, tag as "unknown" and exclude from backend-only view. also emit an annotation when fallback=true.
omar: quick query to reproduce: ```sql
-- per-origin percentiles for the window
SELECT origin, percentile(50, latency_ms) AS p50, percentile(95, latency_ms) AS p95, percentile(99, latency_ms) AS p99, count(*) AS samples
FROM latency_events
WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND rollout='canary' AND time BETWEEN '2026-03-23T13:50:00Z' AND '2026-03-23T14:30:00Z'
GROUP BY origin;
```
liz: alert idea: if merged_p95 - backend_p95 > 60ms and merged_samples > 250 -> fire an advisory alert to the canary channel. low-noise threshold.
rachael: owners: ui-ux-lee for mock, tk for telemetry, omar for query examples + alert rule, docs to update wording on percentiles (i'll take that).
ui-ux-lee: will post Figma link + screenshot tomorrow AM.
metric-bot: rollout annotation: canary weight changed 0.1->0.4 at 14:05, fallback events logged between 14:10-14:15.
rachael: thanks. once the pill exists let's default the console to show a tiny "provenance: merged" indicator so people don't assume backend-only. small UX win but avoids recurring confusion. :+1:
